name: Can I prevent sewer backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, several preventative measures can reduce the risk of sewer backups. Avoid flushing anything other than toilet paper. Dispose of grease in the trash, not down the drain. Consider installing a backflow prevention device, especially if you live in a flood-prone area. Regular professional drain cleaning, especially if you have mature trees near your sewer line, can help prevent root intrusion and maintain clear pipes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent backups by not flushing non-toilet paper items, disposing of grease properly, and considering a backflow preventer. Regular professional drain cleaning is also effective.
